# Tutezy by Vacademy

> Tutezy is a live AI tutor for institutes, schools, course creators and
> corporate trainers. It turns the content an organisation already has
> (PDFs, recorded videos, slides, question banks) into one-to-one whiteboard
> lessons taught live by an AI teacher that speaks in the institute's own
> teacher's cloned voice, asks questions, listens to spoken or typed answers,
> gives hints, revisits weak concepts and reports mastery per student.
> Lessons are taught in English and Hindi. Pricing is per learner-minute
> (₹3 / $0.03; ₹5 / $0.05 with the animated avatar) with no seat licences.
> Made by Vacademy (vacademy.io), an education operating system used by
> coaching institutes, schools and training companies. Site: https://tutezy.ai

## What makes Tutezy different from a chatbot

- It teaches a syllabus rather than answering prompts: every slide is compiled
  once into a teaching plan (topics, concepts, board steps, narration, checks,
  hints, misconceptions), then taught live by a state machine that calls the
  model only where judgment is needed (grading an answer, remediating, answering
  a doubt).
- It writes on a whiteboard as it speaks, sentence by sentence; the live model
  never emits raw HTML, so boards stay faithful to the source material.
- It is grounded in the institute's own content, not the open web.
- It is the institute's teacher: name, photo, cloned voice (15-second sample,
  consent-gated, private to the institute) and optional lip-synced avatar.
- It checks understanding after each concept with a structured decision (score
  against a rubric, capped remediation loops, weak flag), revisits weak concepts
  before moving on, and opens the next lesson with a recap.
- It reports: per-student concept mastery, weak spots per batch, minutes taught,
  CSV export. Every credit spent is itemised.
- Students use it inside the Vacademy learner app (web, Android, iOS). No new app.

## Pricing (September 2026)

- Live lesson: ₹3 / $0.03 per learner per minute (voice or text, whiteboard,
  checks, revisits, notes, insights included).
- With animated teacher avatar shown: ₹5 / $0.05 per learner-minute.
- Teacher voice clone: ₹2,000 / $20 one-time per voice.
- Custom teacher avatar from one photo: ₹10,000 / $100 one-time per teacher.
  Stock avatars are free.
- Lesson preparation (compiling a slide) is a small one-time credit cost shown
  before conversion.
- Prepaid credits, no seat licences, no minimums; volume pricing above 1,000
  students. Example: 100 students × 30 minutes = 3,000 minutes = ₹9,000 / $90.

## Who it is for

Coaching and test-prep institutes (NEET, JEE, UPSC, banking, CA), K-12 schools,
course creators and course platforms, universities and colleges, corporate and
HR training, professional certification providers, independent tutors, content
and training companies, skill-development platforms.

## Blog

Guides on AI tutoring for course creators, test-prep and certification providers,
tutoring businesses, schools and L&D teams. Index: https://tutezy.ai/blog/

- [AI math tutors: teaching beyond the final answer](https://tutezy.ai/blog/ai-math-tutor-step-by-step/): Worked examples, targeted hints, error diagnosis and independent practice, with an algebra lesson and evaluation checklist.
- [AI tutoring for STEM: from explanation to application](https://tutezy.ai/blog/ai-tutoring-for-stem-education/): Physics, biology and coding examples, content preparation and a practical STEM tutoring pilot.
- [Diagnostic assessment for personalized learning](https://tutezy.ai/blog/diagnostic-assessment-personalized-learning/): Sample fraction questions and a process for turning evidence of learning gaps into targeted teaching.
- [Socratic AI tutoring: questions that help students think](https://tutezy.ai/blog/socratic-ai-tutor-questioning/): A sample dialogue, a progressive hint ladder and rules for when to explain directly.
- [Flipped classrooms with AI tutoring: a lesson plan](https://tutezy.ai/blog/flipped-classroom-ai-tutoring/): Preparation, a 50-minute classroom plan and targeted follow-up, with research context.
- [Spaced repetition: a practical four-week study plan](https://tutezy.ai/blog/spaced-repetition-study-plan/): A revision calendar, retrieval tasks for different objectives and an actionable error log.
- [Bloom's 2 sigma problem: can AI tutoring close the gap?](https://tutezy.ai/blog/blooms-2-sigma-problem-ai-tutoring/): What Bloom's 1984 tutoring study found, why later research shrank the effect, and what the newest AI tutoring trials say about one-to-one gains at scale.
- [Checking for understanding: 12 techniques that work online](https://tutezy.ai/blog/checking-for-understanding-techniques/): Twelve ways to check for understanding online and 1:1, from hinge questions to predict-then-reveal, with examples, pitfalls and how an AI tutor uses them.
- [How to improve online course completion rates](https://tutezy.ai/blog/improve-online-course-completion-rates/): Why most learners never finish an online course, which fixes the research supports, and a 30-day plan: shorter units, retrieval, deadlines and live help.
- [How to choose AI tutoring software: 12 questions to ask](https://tutezy.ai/blog/how-to-choose-ai-tutoring-software/): A buyer's checklist for evaluating AI tutoring software: grounding, teaching method, voice, reports, data privacy, total cost, and how to run a two-week pilot.
- [How much does an AI tutor cost? Pricing models compared](https://tutezy.ai/blog/ai-tutor-cost/): Per-seat, per-minute, build-your-own and human tutoring costs compared, with worked examples for a 100-student cohort and the hidden costs to budget for.
- [Will an AI tutor make things up? Keeping it grounded](https://tutezy.ai/blog/ai-tutor-hallucinations-grounding/): Why AI tutors make things up, the design choices that keep one faithful to your own material, and a 10-minute test to run before students see it.
- [How to add an AI tutor to your online course](https://tutezy.ai/blog/add-ai-tutor-to-online-course/): Three ways to add an AI tutor to your course: your platform's assistant, a custom GPT or Claude Project, or a live teaching tutor, and the trade-offs.
- [Turn PDFs, slides and videos into interactive lessons with AI](https://tutezy.ai/blog/turn-pdf-slides-into-interactive-lessons/): How to convert the PDFs, slides and videos you already have into interactive lessons with checks, hints and diagrams, and what a human must still review.
- [AI voice cloning for teachers: consent, quality and cost](https://tutezy.ai/blog/ai-voice-cloning-for-teachers/): Before cloning a teacher's voice for lessons: how much audio it takes, how to record consent, what to tell students, what US law says, and the cost.
- [AI tutoring for certification exam prep: a playbook](https://tutezy.ai/blog/ai-tutoring-certification-exam-prep/): How nursing, accounting, PM and IT exam-prep providers can use AI tutoring for mock-test reviews and weak-area remediation without off-syllabus answers.
- [How to scale a tutoring business with AI](https://tutezy.ai/blog/scale-tutoring-business-with-ai/): For tutoring companies and independent tutors: which work an AI tutor can take on, what must stay human, the margin math, and how to explain it to parents.
- [AI-led employee onboarding training: a guide for L&D](https://tutezy.ai/blog/ai-employee-onboarding-training/): How L&D teams can teach onboarding, compliance and product knowledge one to one with an AI trainer built from existing decks, plus a 30-day rollout plan.
